outcome: Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: Term multiparous women with known interbirth intervals and vaginal deliveries
finding: Contrary to previous findings, prolonged interbirth interval was not associated with slower active labor; however, a slight increase in the duration of the second stage of labor was observed with increased interbirth interval.
mod_finding: Longer interbirth intervals in multiparous women were not associated with slower active phase labor, but were associated with slightly longer second stage labor duration.
